msg: As far as i can tell there are no constant patterns. There may be patterns but they seem to change often. Brown and purple hats seem to give the most points but once I saw low points on one I switched colour for a few turns. I thought of looking for clues like the number of lines on their beards or gnomes on the left of a certain colour, but this made no difference as far as I can tell.I did notice that sometimes I would get a lucky streak if I chose the same colour over and over once they gave over 5 points.Brown seemed to give more than purple most of the time. I have no idea if the basket colour may be a clue for the next gnome to choose, but it is probably not as there were only red and yellow baskets.Nothing on the houses changed and the gnomes appearance never changed so no clues there.I did notice during the pratice rounds the gnomes had spots on their hats and the one with the most spots gave most points. Is this a clue I missed? Maybe you can have more luck.
